observed.caption: Busy urban street filled with buses, cars, vans and motorcycles lined by trees and high-rise buildings under an overcast sky.
observed.description: A wide multi-lane asphalt road in the foreground and center is filled with vehicles including a white hatchback car in the lower center, a red bus on the left viewed from the rear, a blue bus in the center, a white van in front of it, and an orange and white bus on the right foreground with a motorcycle and rider beside it. Another motorcycle with rider is visible on the far left near the sidewalk. Pedestrians are visible on the right sidewalk near shops with blue awnings and on the left sidewalk near the red bus, with more distant figures along the road. Tall buildings line the background, including a blue-glass modern high-rise with spires in the center distance and a tall brown rectangular building on the right. Large leafy green trees are on both sides of the street. Traffic lights on poles are visible on the left and right. An overhead metal arch structure spans the road in the far center. The sky is overcast and lighting is diffuse daylight.
